name: fleet
description: Agent-to-agent reach across a personal fleet (fleet:reach): from Claude Code on any host and platform (WSL or native Windows), run a script, prompt, or query and wait, message a session, or start a named session on another host or platform. Each platform signs into its own Claude account, so built-in peer tools see only their own. Carries the route matrix for headless turns on the target platform, target resolution from the fleet manifest, and a posture that keeps agent launches prompting.

converge_docs_url.title: Converge docs URL
converge_docs_url.description: URL of your own documentation for the fleet-converge command, which reach names when converging dotfiles comes up. Unset: reach names the command with no link.
